zh-CN.title: 新能力会主动来找你
items: 未解锁的操作会保持隐藏，界面更轻更干净
新解锁能力会在真实入口显示一次小红点
语音、图片、位置等重要能力支持聚焦式首次引导

en.title: New abilities find you
items: Locked actions stay hidden to keep the interface focused
Newly unlocked abilities show a one-time dot at their real entry point
Key features such as voice, photos, and location now include focused first-use guidance
